==Requirements:==

 * This document consider that you have already set-up an eclipse instance for making Emfstore product with your custom model. In case if you want to make Emfstore stand-alone product for multiple operating systems then please also configure delta-pack within your eclipse. 
 * A detailed doucmentation to configure delta-pack can be found [http://code.google.com/p/unicase/wiki/Emfstore_product here]. 
 * This document also considers that you have already installed Install EMFStore Framework, if not then you can do it following this [http://code.google.com/p/unicase/wiki/InstallEMFStore tutorial].

==Source:==

 * All the codes for this documentation can be found at our SVN repository using this [http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/developer/CodeExamples/ link]. 
 * We have used the example model project created in the tutorial [http://code.google.com/p/unicase/wiki/RunEMFStoreWithCustomModel Run EMFStore with a custom model].

==Deploy==
Below we describe the complete procedure to create a plugin based Emfstore product with custom model.

 * Open your eclipse instance, if not already opened.
 * Make sure that your model plugin is available in your eclipse-workspace.
 * Create a new "Empty EMF Project" with a meaningful name. 
 * You can see in the image given below that we have already checked out the example model plugins in the workspace for this tutorial and now creating a project which will hold the product configuration.
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/Picture%201.png
 * Once the project is created, create a new "Product Configuration" file within it.
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/Picture%204.png
 * Open the newly created "Product Configuration" file and specify the ID, Version and Name in their respective fields.
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/Picture%205.png
 * Make sure that within the "Product Definition" section "The product configuration is based on:" has value "plug-ins" selected until unless you want to make your product based on features(This tutorial strictly follows the plug-ins based approach only).
 * In the "Product Definition" section, for the field "Product" click the associated button with text "New.." to define the new Eclipse product and its default entry point.
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/Picture%206.png
    * Specify the plugin which holds your product configuration in the "Defining Plug-in" field.
    * Specify a "Product ID".
    * Select "org.unciase.emfstore.server" as the default Product Application.
    * Click on Finish.
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/Picture%2022.png
 
 * Now its time to add your custom model in the dependencies and the core Emfstore plugins.
